lines.say: Fish oil. Does it help you build muscle?
Fish oil is rich in omega three fats, called E P A and D H A.
For building muscle, the evidence is mixed. Most studies show little or no extra growth.
Some studies found slightly less soreness after hard training.
Its strongest case is your heart, not your biceps.
Health groups suggest eating oily fish like salmon about twice a week.
Don't eat fish? A supplement is an option. On blood thinners? Ask your doctor first.
